name: Slovakia: check of forms and supplied documents

common.check: Trial title and EU trial number (if assigned) match the protocol and CTIS.
Every field the assistant answers is answered; fields that belong to the site, investigator, insurer or sponsor are left empty, not invented.
Language is Slovak (bilingual Slovak and English where the guide allows it: K1, M1).
No signature in the CTIS copy unless the current form expressly requires one.
CTIS title follows the naming guide and requirements.json; correct CTIS location.

SK-K1.check: Uses the EudraLex recruitment and informed-consent procedure template version 2.0 (submissions from 1 September 2026), uploaded under Recruitment arrangements.

Describes how candidates are identified, approached, informed, given time to decide and consented, including any use of treating physicians, databases, referrals, advertisements, remote steps or legal representatives.
Member State fields for Slovakia completed (national_fields v105, v108 and, where the pathway applies, v110, v114, v117, v121).
The yes/no answers for incapacitated adults, minors, impartial witness and emergency match the project's populations; each 'yes' section is completed, each 'no' section says not applicable.
Minors: age bands explained and justified; parental authority verification and signature plan stated.
Healthy volunteers: identification and screening described, including databases or recruitment vendors.
Emergency: each Article 35 condition explained for the exact condition and therapeutic window.
Witness route and oral-consent record described.
States that people in custody, serving a prison sentence or held in detention are not enrolled.
Recruitment routes match the recruitment material (SK-K2).

SK-M1.check: One current CV per principal investigator and site, uploaded under Suitability of the investigator.
Shows education, relevant clinical and research experience, current position and GCP training.
Slovak or bilingual; no separate CTIS signature; signed and dated source retained in TMF or ISF.

SK-M2.check: One declaration per principal investigator and site; financial and other interests answered by the investigator.
No separate signature in the CTIS copy; signed and dated source kept in the controlled trial file; live national instruction checked for a republished Ethics Committee form.

SK-M3-SITES.check: Lists every planned Slovak site with the principal investigator's name and position and the planned participants per site or for Slovakia.
Names, addresses and participant numbers match the CTIS structured data, M1/M2 and each site's N1 form.

SK-N1.check: One current Slovakia national site suitability form (2025 update) per site, uploaded under Suitability of the facilities; current form instructions verified.
Describes facility, staff, equipment, pharmacy arrangements, emergency capability and outsourced trial procedures needed by the protocol.
Phase I or bioequivalence unit: facilities, staffing and emergency capability appropriate to the protocol.
Emergency pathway: staff and facilities able to apply it without delaying emergency care.
CTIS copy unsigned only if the underlying suitability confirmation is properly documented; signed source retained where required.

SK-O1.check: Valid insurer-executed certificate covering trial-related injury in Slovakia for the relevant sponsor, trial and period.
Policy scope, territory, dates and identifiers match the application and the expected conduct period.
Insurance wording in every participant document matches the certificate.

SK-P1.check: Distinguishes reimbursement of reasonable expenses from payment for time or inconvenience.
States what will and will not be reimbursed (travel costs), how claims work and whether payment changes after withdrawal.
Amounts, conditions and recipients identical to every participant document.
No financial inducement to parents or legal representatives beyond compensation for expenses and loss connected with participation.

SK-R1.check: EudraLex GDPR compliance statement completed in the CTIS Form section; no duplicate Part II narrative.
No national sentence added (r1_the_sponsor_declares removed); sponsor details match the CTIS application.
Consistent with the privacy sections of the participant documents.

SK-S1.check: Uses the EudraLex biological-samples template in its dedicated placeholder.
Main-trial use, storage period, location, coding, transfers and destruction match the protocol, laboratory manual and participant documents.
Optional future use is described and kept separate from main-trial consent.
Not signed unless the current template expressly requires an attestation.

SK-GMO.check: Official GMO authorisation obtained before the activity starts and included in the required application route.

SK-RADIOACTIVE.check: Official authorisation for planned exposure involving investigational radioactive medicinal products or precursors obtained before the activity starts and included in the required application route.

SK-TRANSPLANT.check: Each site removing or transplanting human organs, tissues or cells holds the applicable transplant-centre authorisation before the activity starts.
